licence.leaseMustBeValidToRenew.source: Boasis research, free zone licence renewal (2026-09-28), Umm Al Quwain Free Trade Zone (UAQ FTZ), lease (UAQ FTZ Regulations (March 2015) 5.4 and 6.4(b): a valid lease is required to hold a licence; the official renewal checklist requires a Renewed Lease Agreement, issued together with the renewed licence, CONFIRMED); https://uaqftz.gov.ae/gallery/Freezone_rules_and_regulations.pdf ; https://uaqftz.gov.ae/gallery/UAQ-FTZ-License-Renewal-Required-Documents.docx.docx

licence.leaseMinRemainingDays.source: Boasis research, free zone licence renewal (2026-09-28), Umm Al Quwain Free Trade Zone (UAQ FTZ), lease (no minimum remaining rule in the Regulations; the 30 day figure in 6.8 is a deadline to renew before licence expiry, not a lease rule); https://uaqftz.gov.ae/gallery/Freezone_rules_and_regulations.pdf

licence.renewalWindow.value: Renew no later than 30 days before the current licence's expiry date.
licence.renewalWindow.source: Boasis research, free zone licence renewal (2026-09-28), Umm Al Quwain Free Trade Zone (UAQ FTZ), renewal window (UAQ FTZ Regulations (March 2015) 6.8, CONFIRMED); https://uaqftz.gov.ae/gallery/Freezone_rules_and_regulations.pdf

licence.renewsTogether.value: Renewed lease agreement, issued with the renewed licence; UBO declaration and UBO passports; insurance copy for a warehouse or land; civil defence certificate for industrial licences. The Operation Fitness Certificate must be renewed annually before licence renewal. No arrears of rent, levies or fines.
licence.renewsTogether.source: Boasis research, free zone licence renewal (2026-09-28), Umm Al Quwain Free Trade Zone (UAQ FTZ), renews together (official renewal checklist and form; Regulations 10.6 and 6.9; CONFIRMED); https://uaqftz.gov.ae/gallery/UAQ-FTZ-License-Renewal-Required-Documents.docx.docx ; https://uaqftz.gov.ae/gallery/UAQ-FTZ-License-Renewal-Application-Form.docx.docx ; https://uaqftz.gov.ae/gallery/Freezone_rules_and_regulations.pdf

licence.afterExpiry.value: Failure to renew on time attracts a fine and may lead to permanent revocation, refusal of renewal or de-registration. Late fees apply if not renewed by the expiry date. Licences will not be renewed after 6 months from the expiry date, and facilities are repossessed when the lease expires unrenewed. The licence can be revoked on written notice if renewal documents are not submitted. Sponsorship of employees can be terminated if the licence or lease is not renewed.
licence.afterExpiry.source: Boasis research, free zone licence renewal (2026-09-28), Umm Al Quwain Free Trade Zone (UAQ FTZ), late renewal (UAQ FTZ Regulations 6.8, 6.15, 7.2(f) and 14.10, and the renewal checklist note, CONFIRMED; amounts left out); https://uaqftz.gov.ae/gallery/Freezone_rules_and_regulations.pdf ; https://uaqftz.gov.ae/gallery/UAQ-FTZ-License-Renewal-Required-Documents.docx.docx
